asked.item: Why no company Page shows in the picker
Listed as Analyst on the company Page
Whether the personal LinkedIn connection worked

verdict.reason: The sentences say the Analyst role does not expose a Page to Blotato, and they give the role change and the fallback.

steps.text: The "No LinkedIn pages found for this account" message is informational, not an error, and your personal LinkedIn profile is already connected.
Your profile must have the Super Admin or Content Admin role, and Analyst access does not expose the Page to Blotato.
Ask a Super Admin to update your role, then reconnect from an incognito Chrome window and select the Page.
If your role stays unchanged, ask a Super Admin or Content Admin to connect the Page to Blotato.
